label: Customer Billing Detail
request: change the page title to 'Eqip.Rite customer dashboard'
markdown:
## Summary
I will change the page's title from "Billing Detail" to "Eqip.Rite customer dashboard" in the page's settings file. Nothing else on the page changes.

## How it works today
The page has two different "titles":
- **Page title** (browser tab / window): set in `customer-billing-detail-page.json` as `"title": "Billing Detail"`.
- **On-screen heading**: the `page-title` of `oj-sp-general-overview-page` in the HTML. It is bound to `$variables.formData.requestNumber`, which `BillingDetailInitChain` fills from `eqp-v1/getEquipriteV1ViewsCustomerRequestDetails`. It shows the request number.

## What changes
Only the page title in the page JSON changes, to 'Eqip.Rite customer dashboard'. The on-screen heading keeps showing the request number, because that tells the customer which request the billing belongs to.

## The change
- `webApps/vbredwoodapp/flows/customer-portal/pages/customer-billing-detail-page.json` — the `"title"` value changes from `"Billing Detail"` to `"Eqip.Rite customer dashboard"`.

## After the change
1. The person opens a request from My Billing as before.
2. The page title (browser tab / window) reads "Eqip.Rite customer dashboard" instead of "Billing Detail".
3. The heading, banner, summary chips, expandable table and back arrow all behave exactly as before.

## Risks
- The text is used exactly as written in the request: "Eqip.Rite", not "EquipRite". If that spelling is a typo, it is a one-word fix in the same line.
- The on-screen heading is deliberately left alone. If the intent was to replace the request number heading too, that is a separate one-line change in the HTML, and the request number would no longer be shown as the heading.
- No chains, variables, REST calls or other pages are affected.

## How to test
1. Open the app and go to My Billing (`customer-portal/customer-my-billing`).
2. Open any request to reach the billing detail page (`/vp/shell/customer-portal/customer-billing-detail`).
3. Check the page title (browser tab) reads "Eqip.Rite customer dashboard".
4. Check the on-screen heading still shows the request number and the banner details and chips still load.
5. Expand and collapse a line in the table, then click the back arrow and confirm it returns to My Billing.

## Questions
None
